court: Hon'ble Special Court for PMLA / CBI, Bengaluru

prosecution_grounds.evidence: Observed high-speed transit via Hebbal flyover to Kempegowda International Airport and possession of un-hosted foreign crypto wallets.
Demonstrated use of burner SIM-boxes and remote encrypted wipe commands on seized mobile hardware.
Ongoing structuring across 14 identified mule accounts requires custodial interrogation to seize proceeds of crime under Section 19 PMLA.
